messages:
Maya (partnerships): Nimbus follow-up: they asked if we can offer a staggered discount that increases when they hit consumption thresholds. Also want the SI onboarding credit to be claimable via the partner portal.
Owen (sales): That's a strong ask. Staggered discount would be great for making renewals sticky. Suggest thresholds at 50%, 100%, 150% of committed monthly run-rate with +5% increments.
Diego (finance): Staggered discounts are doable but must be clearly described as retroactive or prospective. If retroactive, we need to treat some revenue as variable. I prefer prospective credits after threshold verification.
Hannah (legal): If credits are claimable by SI via partner portal, need partner T&C addendum and anti-fraud checks. Also cap on allowable claims.
Kai (partner_ops): Partner portal support: we can create a claim flow tied to partner_credit_code, but we need partner invoice and proof of work. Marketplace metadata must include partner_claim_code and claim_deadline.
Maya (partnerships): Proposed simplified terms: base discount applied up front. When Nimbus crosses thresholds verified monthly, we apply an off-invoice partner credit (prospective) for the remainder of the term. SI files claim with partner_id and invoice ref.
Owen (sales): Works. Also request a section in the AE one-pager showing example math: commit $300k, start at 20% discount, cross 150% in month 4 -> additional 5% applied prospectively leading to $X savings.
Diego (finance): I'll recalibrate the P&L with prospective credits only. Also flag: if partner claims exceed budget, we reserve right to cap cumulative SI credits at 10% of committed USD.
Hannah (legal): Add cap language and claim audit rights. Also require SI to maintain records for 12 months and allow us to reject fraudulent claims.
Kai (partner_ops): I'll add sample claim payload: ```
{
  "partner_claim_code": "SI-0591-CREDIT-2024",
  "partner_id": "SI-0591",
  "invoice_reference": "INV-98765",
  "work_description": "onboarding services - 40 hours",
  "claimed_amount_usd": "25000",
  "claim_deadline": "2025-01-15"
}
```
Maya (partnerships): Good. Let's finalize the payload and legal clauses today so we can submit to marketplace by the deadline.
